name_input: M/S. THE METAL POWDER CO. LTD
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page for slug 'the-metal-powder-company-limited' (https://importkey.com/countries/india/the-metal-powder-company-limited) shows 'Total Shipments 1029 Records detected', 'Latest Cargo 2026-02-28', and row-level export records, e.g.: '2026-02-28 | THE METAL POWDER COMPANY LIMITED | CARLFORS BRUK AB | ALUMINIUM POWDER DU- | TUTICORIN SEA INTUT1, India | Gothenburg, SWEDEN | 76031090 | BOL 1119809'; '2026-02-27 | ... | NATIONAL INDUSTRIES CO. | ALUMINIUM PASTE CO 99DP- | TUTICORIN SEA INTUT1, India | Shuwaikh, KUWAIT | 32129030 | BOL 1077239'; '2026-02-25 | ... | ROS-CHIMIA LTD | GOLD BRONZE POWDER B44- | TONDIAPET ICD INTVT6, India | Novorossiysk, RUSSIA | 32064990 | BOL 9990691'. Source counter: page claims 1029 total shipments; 5 individual dated export rows actually rendered on the free view (plus aggregate partner/port tables: 53 trading partners, 51 port lanes, top ports TUTICORIN SEA 74, TONDIAPET ICD 27).
note: Export side is factually confirmed with dated customs/B-L records: destinations Sweden, Kuwait, Peru, Russia, Germany; HS codes seen 76031090, 76032000, 32129030, 32064990. Note on HS: declared codes 320649 and 321290 are both actually present in real shipments (32064990 gold bronze powder to Russia; 32129030 aluminium paste to Kuwait), so the declared HS is consistent with observed records — no correction needed; the company also ships 7603 aluminium powder, which is outside the declared pair. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, annual-report India sales split) could NOT be verified: the web_search backend returned connection errors on every attempt, volza/eximpedia/trademo returned HTTP 403, importgenius served a JS challenge, and the company site domain did not resolve. Therefore domestic_status = unknown, not 'none_found' — absence of evidence here is a tooling limitation, not a finding. Revenue and export volume figures: null (not public on the free views; not invented). Registry/catalogue data deliberately not used. Slug variants tried: 'the-metal-powder-co-ltd' (JS shell, no rows), 'the-metal-powder-company-limited' (rows present), 'the-metal-powder-company-ltd' (JS shell, no rows).
